def _line(x, y):
    """Resistant pairwise slope start, then refit with bounded influence."""
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    dx = x[i] - x[j]
    good = np.abs(dx) > 1e-06
    if not good.any():
        return np.array([1.0, np.median(y - x) if len(x) else 0.0])
    slope = np.median((y[i[good]] - y[j[good]]) / dx[good])
    b = np.array([slope, np.median(y - slope * x)])
    a = np.column_stack((x, np.ones(len(x))))
    for _ in range(8):
        r = y - a @ b
        s = max(0.0001, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r))))
        w = 1.0 / np.hypot(1.0, r / (2.5 * s))
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(a * w[:, None], y * w, rcond=None)[0]
    return b

def _design(tau, x, h, p, dt, t, memory):
    tau = np.asarray(tau, dtype=float)
    after = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    a = after[:, None] / tau
    b = dt[:, None] / tau
    decay = np.exp(-a)
    jump = -np.expm1(-b)
    preload = memory * np.exp(-dt.sum() / tau)
    gap = h[:, None] - p @ (decay * jump) - preload
    dgap = -(p @ (decay * (a * jump - b * np.exp(-b)) / tau)) - preload * dt.sum() / tau ** 2
    q = t[:, None] / tau
    shape = -np.expm1(-q)
    dshape = -np.exp(-q) * q / tau
    curves = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * shape, x[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]), axis=2)
    rates = np.column_stack((gap / tau, x))
    dc = dgap[:, None, :] * shape + gap[:, None, :] * dshape
    dr = (dgap - gap / tau) / tau
    return (curves, rates, dc, dr)

def _crossing(t, start, curves, threshold):
    times = np.r_[0.0, t]
    values = np.column_stack((start, curves))
    crossed = values >= threshold[:, None]
    first = crossed.argmax(axis=1)
    answer = np.where(crossed[:, 0], 0.0, t[-1])
    rows = np.flatnonzero(first > 0)
    k = first[rows]
    lo = values[rows, k - 1]
    hi = values[rows, k]
    answer[rows] = times[k - 1] + (times[k] - times[k - 1]) * (threshold[rows] - lo) / (hi - lo)
    return answer

def _sweep(x, y):
    if len(x) < 4 or np.ptp(x) < 0.5:
        return None
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    dx = x[i] - x[j]
    good = np.abs(dx) > 1e-06
    gain = np.median((y[i] - y[j])[good] / dx[good])
    bias = np.median(y - gain * x)
    r = y - (gain * x + bias)
    mad = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r)))
    clean = np.abs(r) <= np.clip(4 * mad, 0.002, 0.02)
    if clean.sum() < max(4, len(x) // 2 + 1) or np.ptp(x[clean]) < 0.5:
        return None
    return np.polyfit(x[clean], y[clean], 1)
